description: Two catalogs of exactly 52 bytes each as build.mjs materializes them (JSON.stringify with two-space indent plus a trailing newline — measured, not assumed) under a 60-byte maximumTotalInputBytes: one resource fits, two do not, and the same resource mapped twice also does not.
